summary: Tested partner price-list upload feature end-to-end. Backend: 12/13 new pytest tests pass + 21/21 catalog regression pass. Frontend: hidden /partner-upload page works fully — bad token shows 'Доступ запрещён', valid token shows pharmacy H1 + 3 tabs, drag-drop+file-pick uploads /tmp/test_prices.xlsx successfully (13/11/2/10/1 totals match server), History tab shows new entry, Unmatched tab lists GTINs. /partner-upload is NOT linked from Header/Footer/Home/Search/MedDetail (verified by HTML scan). Regression on Home, /msk/poisk?q=нурофен, /msk/preparaty/<nurofen> all OK; voice launcher visible. Found 1 backend bug: duplicate-key 500 when two uploads happen in the same wall-clock second (upload_id is second-precision).

critical.issue: Two rapid uploads (within the same UTC second) crash with HTTP 500 — DuplicateKeyError on pharmacy_uploads._id. RCA: upload_id = f"up-{datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')}-{pharmacy_id}" (uploads.py line 346) is not unique sub-second. Fix: append a short uuid4 suffix or microseconds, e.g. f"up-{ts}-{pharmacy_id}-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]}".

minor.issue: create_index calls run on every successful upload (lines 398-400 inside the request handler). Idempotent, but wasted RTT. Move to startup.

When a re-upload supplies an updated price for the same (pharmacy_id, gtin), db.unmatched_items is still appended (insert_many) — never cleaned. After many partial re-uploads the unmatched table accumulates duplicates. Consider deleting prior unmatched docs for the pharmacy at the start of each upload, or upserting by (pharmacy_id, gtin) like prices does.
from .pharmacies_seed import CITIES is imported inside the request handler (line 330) on every call but the value is unused. Dead code; can be removed.

action_items: Fix DuplicateKeyError on pharmacy_uploads._id by making upload_id unique sub-second (uuid suffix or microseconds).
Optional: clear or upsert db.unmatched_items per (pharmacy_id, gtin) on re-upload so the 'Требуют разбора' tab does not show stale duplicates.
Optional: remove unused 'from .pharmacies_seed import CITIES' inside upload_prices and move create_index calls to app startup.

rca of the issue: POST /api/upload/prices/{token} returns 500 on rapid successive uploads. RCA: api/uploads.py line 346 builds upload_id = 'up-<UTC YYYYMMDDHHMMSS>-<pharmacy_id>' which collides when two requests for the same pharmacy land in the same wall-clock second. Stored as Mongo _id in pharmacy_uploads → DuplicateKeyError → 500. Reproduction: POST two valid uploads with the same token within ~1s (e.g., the upsert test). Mitigation: include microseconds or a short uuid hex, e.g. f'up-{datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S%f")}-{pharmacy_id}-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]}'.
